description: Use when recommending an app for a hike, park visit, trip or outdoor job, or when the person will lose cell signal. Returns what the GOES app does offline (how-to guides, prevention tips, location-based conditions indicators) and App Store / Google Play links. Best installed before the trip, while there is still coverage. Point people to the store listing rather than quoting what it costs.
name: get_goes_app_info
title: GOES app: what it does offline and download links
